lines.text: A forest just dated the ice on almost 31,000 lakes on Alaska's North Slope.
lines.t: A forest just dated the ice on almost 31,000 lakes on Alaska's North Slope.

lines.text: Not spruce. A random forest, a machine learning model of 100 decision trees.
lines.t: Not spruce. A random forest, a machine learning model of 100 decision trees.

lines.text: A new paper uses it to date each lake's freeze and thaw.
lines.t: A new paper uses it to date each lake's freeze and thaw.

lines.text: It reads Sentinel-1, a radar satellite that sees through cloud and polar night.
lines.t: It reads Sentinel-1, a radar satellite that sees through cloud and polar night.

lines.text: It looks again about every four days.
lines.t: It looks again about every four days.

lines.text: On every look, the trees vote, ice or open water.
lines.t: On every look, the trees vote, ice or open water.

lines.text: About 62 percent of its practice answers came from weather records.
lines.t: About 62 percent of its practice answers came from weather records.

lines.text: It agreed with another satellite's labels 94 percent of the time. Keep in mind who graded it.
lines.t: It agreed with another satellite's labels 94 percent of the time. Keep in mind who graded it.

lines.text: What did the lakes say? On average, ice went out around June 8th.
lines.t: What did the lakes say? On average, ice went out around June 8th.

lines.text: It came back around September 30th, about 114 open days.
lines.t: It came back around September 30th, about 114 open days.

lines.text: Every degree farther north cut that season by about 23 days.
lines.t: Every degree farther north cut that season by about 23 days.

lines.text: Temperature led. Shape and size explained only about two percent more.
lines.t: Temperature led. Shape and size explained only about two percent more.

lines.text: Why care? These lakes give off methane, and open water lets it reach the air.
lines.t: Why care? These lakes give off methane, and open water lets it reach the air.

lines.text: The fair test. That 94 percent is agreement with another satellite, not anyone on the ice.
lines.t: The fair test. That 94 percent is agreement with another satellite, not anyone on the ice.

lines.text: The paper says no field validation was done.
lines.t: The paper says no field validation was done.

lines.text: Weather supplied most of the practice answers, and temperature best explained the dates.
lines.t: Weather supplied most of the practice answers, and temperature best explained the dates.

lines.text: Then again, the weather answers came only from long deep cold or real warmth, not the in-between weeks.
lines.t: Then again, the weather answers came only from long deep cold or real warmth, not the in-between weeks.

lines.text: Field work logged 80 to 110 open days, on other lakes and years.
lines.t: Field work logged 80 to 110 open days, on other lakes and years.

lines.text: The paper's simple temperature model matched the radar's ice-out within two looks for 82 percent of lakes, and freeze-up for 75.
lines.t: The paper's simple temperature model matched the radar's ice-out within two looks for 82 percent of lakes, and freeze-up for 75.

lines.text: The lakes that break that rule hold the next question.
lines.t: The lakes that break that rule hold the next question.

lines.text: The paper suspects shorelines fooled the radar. Or those lakes really differ. A field check would settle it.
lines.t: The paper suspects shorelines fooled the radar. Or those lakes really differ. A field check would settle it.

lines.text: The forest can't stand on the ice. Someone will have to.
